# Al's Hideaway

> Al's Hideaway is a family-owned, pet-friendly cabin, RV and campground property in Pipe Creek, Texas, in the Texas Hill Country. It has 13 handcrafted log cabins, 10 full-hookup pull-through RV sites, and 9 cowboy campsites on 20 acres with two creeks and dark night skies, about 15 minutes from Bandera and Boerne, 20 minutes from Helotes, and 45 minutes from downtown San Antonio.

Also listed as: Al's Hideaway Cabin and RV Rentals, LLC; Al's Hideaway Cabins and RV Rentals; Al's Hideaway Cabin and RV Space; Al's Hideaway Cabins & RV Park; Stay Texas Hill Country (website). The old website alshideaway.com now redirects here.

Al's Hideaway has no pet fees and no cleaning fees, and is the closest campground to the Albert & Bessie Kronkosky State Natural Area. Guests can book directly at staytexashillcountry.com and use promo code FUN for 10% off direct online stays of 2+ nights. Rates change daily; see live pricing and availability on the booking page.

## Quick facts
- Location: 299 Willow Springs Dr, Pipe Creek, TX 78063 (Bandera County)
- Drive times: Bandera ~15 min, Boerne ~15 min (straight down Hwy 46), Helotes ~20 min, San Antonio ~45 min
- Cabins: 13 handcrafted log cabins with air conditioning, private bathrooms and WiFi; 4 are one-bedroom cabins with full kitchens, and MeMaw's Cabin has a fenced yard
- RV: 10 full-hookup pull-through RV sites (20/30/50 amp), up to 85 ft, no backing in
- Camping: 9 cowboy campsites for tents
- On site: swimming pool, pavilion, outdoor kitchen, store (firewood, snacks, hot food, sno cones, smoothies, souvenirs), Energy & Drink Bar (coffee, espresso, energy drinks)
- Good for: couples, bikers and riding clubs, church groups, family reunions, retreats, weddings and events, international visitors
- Not offered: no hot tub; the property is on two creeks, not on a river or lake
- Owners are Visit San Antonio SA Hospitality Champions and T.A.C.O. (Texas Association of Campground Owners) members
